title: What Is Fiscal Deficit and Why Does the Budget Target It? Explained with 2026-27 Figures
seoTitle: What Is Fiscal Deficit? India's 2026-27 Target Explained
seoDescription: Fiscal deficit is the gap between government spending and non-debt income, filled by borrowing. India targets 4.3% of GDP in 2026-27. Here's how it works.
excerpt: A worked example of fiscal, revenue and primary deficit, how the Centre borrows through G-secs, small savings and T-bills, the new debt target, states' 3% cap and where 2026-27 stands now.
